description: Save a video's thumbnail (cover image) as jpg, png or webp to a folder on this machine; returns the path. For YouTube and other sites it takes the largest image the site lists; for a local file, its cover art, else a frame from the first tenth of the video. Files go to dir, else VID2CONTEXT_DOWNLOAD_DIR, else ~/Downloads/vid2context.

dir.description: Folder to save to: absolute, ~/..., or relative to the default folder

url.description: Video URL, YouTube id or local file path

name: download_thumbnail
title: Save a video thumbnail
